notes: Germany + Malaysia. Aldi Talk rules from official activity-window PDF (valid from 2026-01-01). CallYa rules from official Vodafone FAQ quoted by prepaid-deutschland.de (2025-08). Hotlink 365-day pass from official FAQ. Germany requires real-name ID verification (VideoIdent) — acquisition from abroad is hard; documented for completeness.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official activity-window PDF (valid 2026-01-01): credit usable 12 months after activation; each top-up starts a NEW activity window whose length depends on top-up amount (€5 → 4 months; larger amounts longer). After window ends: 2 months passive reachability, then deactivation. Credit refundable on deactivation.

keep.action: €5 top-up every 4 months (official ladder) ≈ €15/yr; or larger top-up for longer window. After window lapse, 2-month passive grace before deactivation.

routes.chinaActivation: German prepaid real-name registration (VideoIdent/PostIdent with passport + German address) — activation from China is impractical; acquisition realistically requires Germany presence or a DE-resident helper.
routes.payment: Aldi store vouchers (cash) or bank/card online.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad generally works; EU-roaming focused tariff, China receiving unverified — 验证中.
routes.refund: Official PDF: remaining credit refundable on deactivation (on request).
guideSteps: Acquire starter pack in Germany (store) with ID registration.
If window lapses: top up within 2-month passive grace.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official FAQ (quoted 2025-08): CallYa tariff is unlimited-duration BUT unused >90 days → Vodafone MAY terminate; SMS warning first; 4 weeks to object; then blocked (credit refundable). Receiving messages does NOT count as usage — user-initiated action required.

keep.action: User-initiated usage or top-up at least every 3 months (Vodafone recommends quarterly top-up, small amounts OK — €5 min). 90-day inactivity → warning SMS → 4-week objection window → block.

routes.chinaActivation: German ID verification (VideoIdent) + German address required — impractical from China.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works; China rates 验证中.
routes.holdReason: Strictest major-market window found (90 days) + Germany KYC barrier; document as reference, not recommendation.
routes.tariffSummary: 90-day usage rule with SMS warning + 4-week objection; quarterly top-up recommended.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Official FAQ (2026-09-26): Hotlink Pantas 365-day Active Period Passes — 1GB RM2.00, 2GB RM4.00, 5GB RM10.00. Maxis network (MY #1 coverage).

keep.action: Corrected 2026-09-26: the RM2/365-day figure was a data pass, not number retention. Real keep-alive is ~RM30/yr via validity top-up ladder. Still among the world's cheapest retention routes.

routes.chinaActivation: Malaysia prepaid requires passport registration (MCMC rules); eSIM available in Hotlink app — overseas-first activation unverified.
routes.payment: App top-up via card; international acceptance 验证中.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad reported working (community); rates 验证中.
routes.tariffSummary: RM2/yr 365-day active-period pass — current global floor for number retention.
guideSteps: Acquire Hotlink prepaid (MY store) + passport registration.
Buy RM2 365-day pass in app yearly.
